JSON-LD Menu schema gave 77 raw items across 10 sections; cross-checked against the page's own rendered menuBook category-nav (menuCategories array) and all 10 category names/counts matched exactly (Most Ordered:12, Sandwiches:10, Appetizers:10, Lunch Menu:8, Combination Platters:3, Wraps:9, Side Orders:7, Desserts:4, Beverages:3, Salads:11 = 77), confirming the capture is not truncated. All 12 "Most Ordered" items were exact-name duplicates of items already listed under their real sections, so that carousel section was dropped entirely, leaving 65 unique dishes across 9 sections. DoorDash storefront is a tier-3 marketplace source, not first-party -- filed at medium confidence.
